content.short: CoinRaces is a Telegram Web3 game for two-minute 3D horse-racing predictions with crypto rewards.
content.description: CoinRaces is a live prediction game built around short 3D horse races. The project site describes two-minute races where players pick winners and earn crypto rewards when their predictions are correct. It fits the TON games set as a Telegram-friendly racing and prediction experience rather than a standard casino or token page. Join CoinRaces - live Web3-powered crypto horse racing!. Make predictions in 2-minute long 3D horse races - pick winners, and earn real crypto rewards for success.
